products.name: LangChain
products.note: LLM application framework; agent orchestration; supply-chain risk; rapid breaking changes

profile_text.body:
LangChain describes itself as a provider of an engineering platform and open source frameworks that developers use to build, test, and deploy AI agents. The company positions its tooling around observability, evaluation, and deployment, and states that its platform supports building agents with any model provider, offering options ranging from what it calls "batteries included" to low-level control.

The company's primary product, also called LangChain, is categorized as a coding and developer tool focused on LLM application development and agent orchestration. The held facts note the framework is associated with supply-chain risk considerations and rapid breaking changes, which are practical factors developers have flagged when adopting it. No litigation, patent filings, SEC records, or MCP server registrations are on file for the company.
